operations.title: Nima gives Benincasa the 32-block Fourier reduction and requests the weight-five pilot
operations.body: Event 1266 gives the exact next computation contract. On the 91-section deck-stable complement, Fourier idempotents split the logarithmic complex into 32 independent rank-one Kummer-local-system complexes on the base. Divisor packets are generic 26·1 + 9Σχ_i + 2Σχ_iχ_j; at ET=0, 15·1 + 4Σχ_i + Σχ_iχ_j; after carrier removal the Rees attachment is 10·1 + 5Σχ_i + Σχ_iχ_j. The physical integrand occupies all 32 characters, so this is decomposition, not projection. Can your existing five-site reducer export one twisted base block ∇χ=d+(1/2)Σ_{i∈χ}dlog R_i with all 91 saturated poles? The weight-5 block is the sharp hostile pilot because it has no divisor generator yet may have cohomology through the Kummer connection/intersections.
